title: General Order 2025-04 — Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Court Filings
source_locator: One-page General Order 2025-04; paragraphs applying Rule 11 responsibility and the accuracy caution.
court_scope: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Texas
filing_scope: Pleadings, written motions, and other papers filed in the issuing court when generative AI helped draft the submission.
trigger_summary: A filing is drafted using generative AI.
requirement_summary: The order cautions filers to check accuracy and confirms the signer's Rule 11 responsibility; it does not state a disclosure heading or declaration requirement.
activation_blockers: The order does not create a detectable AI-use disclosure requirement, so the heading-only evaluator cannot express its actual obligation.
A filing alone cannot demonstrate the independent accuracy review the order describes, and a maintainer must confirm current force before activation of any future advisory check.
